spec.name: QC (sampleC)
spec.script:
echo "sample=sampleC" > sampleC.qc.txt
    echo "fastqc=0.12.1" >> sampleC.qc.txt
    echo "gc_content=41" >> sampleC.qc.txt
    grep '^aligner' sampleC.dedup.bam >> sampleC.qc.txt

    if [ "false" = "true" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: adapter contamination above threshold for sampleC" >&2
        echo "QC gate failed" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
